# Fjord

Fjord sets a dusk-blue base with leaf-green accents and cyan selections. The recorded description credits the blue and cyan separation, muted backgrounds and balanced accents with improving readability and focus while editing, and the theme index lists dark mode only.

![Fjord screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jshuntley/fjord-obsidian/HEAD/images/obsidian.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Fjord"
    author: "Josh Huntley"
    repo:   "jshuntley/fjord-obsidian"
    slug:   "fjord"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/fjord"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/jshuntley/fjord-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jshuntley/fjord-obsidian/HEAD/images/obsidian.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a dusk-blue base with leaf-green accents and cyan selections to give Obsidian a calm, high-contrast interface. Use crisp blue/cyan separation, muted backgrounds, and balanced accents to boost readability and focus while editing notes."
}
```
